body:
Actually looking at it, I think we should just revert #105901 for now, and I'll have another look at how to reduce these in 3.x / 4.6 (it's not absolutely pressing) under a little less time pressure.

It looks like 4.x is relying on the `NOTIFICATION_TRANSFORM_CHANGED` from `VisualInstances` a lot more than in 3.x (where this was forward ported from), so there might be more regressions here.

...

The problem stems from `VisualInstance` requiring these notifications only when FTI is off. Derived nodes otoh are likely currently relying on this inherited request (when they should be making their own request).

Switching off the behaviour in a parent class (as allowed currently and used by `SoftBody`) is extremely hacky as it can break other mechanisms (as evidenced here).

The entire transform system for `SoftBody` is currently very badly thought out (imo) and needs reworking, this is something I discussed with mihe on RC, they had to do some bodges in Jolt because it wasn't clear how it *should* work (with relative and absolute xforms). Fixing `SoftBody` without causing regressions in child nodes will be interesting for someone in the future. 😁
